title: Lunch Time at School
intro: It is lunch time for Class 2. We use and to join two ideas that go together.

sections.title: Fill in and.

items.q: Tara has rice ___ dal in her tiffin.
Yusuf washed his hands ___ sat down to eat.
I like apples ___ grapes.

sections.title: Match the two parts with and.
Join the two sentences with and.

items.q: Neha ate a sandwich. Neha drank juice.
items.a: Neha ate a sandwich and drank juice.

items.q: Leo has a red bottle. Max has a red bottle.
items.a: Leo and Max have red bottles.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: "And" is a joining word.
"Puri and chole" uses and to join two foods.
"And" is a naming word.

sections.title: Write two foods you like. Join them with and.
sections.a: Answers will vary, e.g. "I like idli and sambar."

title: A Rainy Day at Home
intro: It is raining in Bengaluru, so Diya stays home. We use but to join two ideas that are different.

sections.title: Fill in but.

items.q: Diya wanted to play outside, ___ it was raining.
The sky is grey, ___ the house is warm.
I have an umbrella, ___ my brother does not.

sections.title: Circle and or but.
Match the start to the best ending.

items.left: I wanted to fly my kite,
items.right: but the rain did not stop.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: We use but when two ideas are different.
"I am tired but happy" is correct.
"It rained, but the ground got wet" is a good sentence.

sections.title: Finish this: I like the rain, but ...
sections.a: Answers will vary, e.g. "I like the rain, but I cannot go out."

title: Choosing at the Ice Cream Shop
intro: Kabir is choosing an ice cream at a shop in Jumeirah. We use or to show a choice.

sections.title: Fill in or.

items.q: Do you want a cone ___ a cup?
Kabir can pick mango ___ chocolate.
Should we sit inside ___ outside?

sections.title: Circle and, but or or.

items.before: Would you like a small cup

sections.title: Match each question to its ending.
Circle True or False.

items.q: We use or to show a choice.
"Do you want juice or water?" asks you to choose.
"I ate rice or dal for lunch" means I ate both.

sections.title: Write a question with or about ice cream.

items.q: Use the word or.
items.a: Answers will vary, e.g. "Do you want a cone or a cup?"

title: Holi in the Park
intro: Ananya and her friends are playing Holi in the park. Choose and, but or or.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: "Do you want pink or blue?" uses the right joining word.
"I fell down and I did not cry" uses the best joining word.
"Mum and Dad played Holi with us" is correct.

sections.title: Circle the correct joining word.

items.before: Do you want a water gun

items.after: it was time to go home.

sections.title: Fill in and, but or or.

items.q: Will you wear a white shirt ___ an old shirt?
Grandma did not play, ___ she gave us gujiyas.
We danced ___ sang Holi songs.
Do you want to play with water ___ dry colours?

sections.title: Join the two sentences with but.

items.q: The colours were bright. The colours were hard to wash off.
items.a: The colours were bright, but they were hard to wash off.

sections.title: Write a sentence about a festival. Use and.
sections.a: Answers will vary; check the sentence uses and correctly.

title: The Global Village Visit
intro: Sana's family visits Global Village in Dubai. Use and, but or or to join the sentences.

sections.title: Join the two sentences with the word in brackets.

items.q: We saw the India stall. We saw the Egypt stall. (and)
items.a: We saw the India stall and the Egypt stall.

items.q: Sana wanted a toy. It cost too much. (but)
items.a: Sana wanted a toy, but it cost too much.

items.q: We can ride the wheel. We can watch the show. (or)
items.a: We can ride the wheel or watch the show.

sections.title: Circle the correct joining word.

items.before: Pick one. Do you want churros

sections.title: Fill in and, but or or.

items.q: The lights were pretty ___ bright.
We were tired, ___ we did not want to go home.
Shall we eat now ___ after the show?
Sana ___ her brother rode the boat.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: "But" joins two ideas that are different.
"Do you want tea and milk?" is the best way to ask someone to choose one.
We can use and to join two names.
